inference.temporal_compatibility: 25Hz explicit real source sequence; model trained frame-index cadence is not recalibrated
inference.primary_body_input: released ExMR RTMW COCO23 with >5.5 binary visibility
inference.control_body_input: original GVHMR COCO17, extra6 RTMW anatomical foot points with binary visibility
inference.extra6: RTMW anatomical foot landmarks, not skate contacts

comparison_protocol.crop: Same known source frames/person/camera. SAM uses raw detector bbox with native 1.25 padding; ExMR uses 192:256 aspect with native 1.2 padding. Earlier repeated-expanded GVHMR-bbox protocol retained as a failed input control.
comparison_protocol.projection: Raw camera diagnostics use native Brown mid-exposure; common state uses the existing native exposure/rolling projection.
comparison_protocol.sam3db_body_native: Retained MHR body-only decoder tensors and SAM features in Data; not represented as SMPL-X.
comparison_protocol.world_state: Each network supplies its own P/Q/local reference. One continuous 76-95s body curve; fixed shared S01 shape, scale, shoe and camera. No inherited GVHMR body correction layer or per-model trajectory alignment.
comparison_protocol.ice: Finite soft ice residual remains in the objective; no ice augmented-Lagrangian or millimetre delivery gate.
comparison_protocol.contact: Only source-supported observations; network anatomical feet, external boot regions, steel material points and static logits retain distinct semantics.
comparison_protocol.cadence_caution: existing SO(3)/continuous-state interpolation; not 50Hz neural inference

raw_camera_comparison.scope: raw camera-coordinate SMPL-X at the original 25Hz exposures, before any world solve
raw_camera_comparison.projection: native Brown at midpoint; no rolling/exposure compensation in this diagnostic

exmr_final.physical_maximum_status: not_certified: historical field includes finite domain penalties for undefined sections

results.gvhmr: One accepted and retained joint step; own-reference replay exact. Still unaccepted world trajectory.
results.exmr_final: Zero accepted steps; no quality-valid fitted result; initial_attempt and last_attempt preserved. Rejection is not a millimetre ice gate.
results.exmr_prefoot: Read-only unoptimized common-state diagnosis; no fitting or optimized-result claim.
results.decision: No replacement of satisfied S01, no full-program extension or further tuning. Prefoot is only an initial-state review candidate.
limitations: Model pelvis G=Pxy is not CoM or actual measured displacement. All candidates retain abnormal large root drift.
Boot-region zero residual means inside an uncertainty region, not exact zero-pixel blade/material alignment. No precise steel curve is admitted.
Eleven source-supported exposures across 19 seconds; other contact-foot frames remain unknown.
Undefined collar sections are not measured penetration. The legacy named maximum can include a finite domain penalty; see explicit unknown rows.
ExMR 45D finger poses stay in raw Data outputs; the current common solver/player does not optimize fingers.

dependencies.model_and_runtime_distribution: External Data only; repository contains no credentials, runtime environments or downloaded model payloads.
